paragraphs: R. Abba bar Kahana. He objected to R. Abba bar Pappi. R. Avdimi of Tzippori asked him. R. Avin died on a festival, and he eulogized him after the festival. R. Elazar bar Ḥaggaya supported him [מסמיך ליה; exact relationship or action requires review]. R. Assi said: R. Mani said, Ḥullin 21a; Kiddushin 13a. R. Armenya asked him, and they ruled for him. R. Borki before him. R. Berekhya: see R. Tanḥum bar Pasha. He released Gamliel of Kuntya and R. Gamliel his grandson from vows. R. Gamliel bar Ila'ah asked before him. R. Gamliel Zuga asked him. R. Gamliel bar Inino asked him. He wrote to R. Hoshaya bar Shami. He ruled for R. Hillel of Kefari. R. Zerika in Zeiri's name. R. Ḥuna raised an objection before him. He heard Ḥizkiyah expound, Jerusalem Talmud, Demai 1, halakhah 3. See Jerusalem Talmud, Nazir 7, halakhah 2: 'R. Mana bar Ḥizkiyah said: Do you remember R. Yaakov bar Aḥa standing here?' This appears a scribal error; it should read 'R. Mana said to R. Ḥizkiyah: Do you remember,' etc. At the beginning of HaGozel Etzim in the Jerusalem Talmud he heard Ḥizkiyah expound in R. Yaakov bar Aḥa's name. R. Ḥiyya bar Aḥa. R. Ḥiyya bar Adda asked before him. R. Mani spoke to R. Ḥanina, Mo'ed Katan 20b. R. Ḥananyah before him. R. Mani said: R. Ḥisda said, Menaḥot 21a. R. Mani said in R. Yehudah's name, in R. Yose the Galilean's name. He asked R. Yudan. R. Mani asked R. Yoḥanan, Menaḥot there. R. Yonah of Botzra asked him. R. Yusta bar Shunam asked him. Yusti—or Isti bar Shunam—asked R. Mani, Shekalim 1. R. Yose of Mamlaḥaya. R. Mani said: R. Yannai said, Niddah 61b; so it should read. R. Yaakov said: R. Mani said, Bava Batra 59b. R. Yitzḥak of Gufeta before him. R. Naḥman in R. Mani's name. R. Naftali asked him. Ulla before him. R. Ezra asked him. R. Reuven asked before him. R.B.B.Ḥ. [רבב״ח; provisionally Rabbah bar bar Ḥana] in R. Mani's name. Bar Shelamya the scribe asked him. R. Shammai. R. Shammay spoke to him. R. Shemuel bar Avudmi. R. Tanḥum bar Pappa.
